question: The Causative organism of peptic ulcer is a:
solution:
The correct answer is a __**bacterium**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **most common cause of peptic ulcers is a bacterial infection** from Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori).
 
• H. pylori **damages the mucus that protects the lining of your stomach** and duodenum, allowing stomach acids to get through to the lining.
 
• This can cause pain, inflammation, and sometimes painful sores called **peptic ulcers**
 
• Your doctor can test your blood, breath, or stool to see if you have an H. pylori infection.
 
• They may also look inside your stomach and duodenum with an endoscopy or x-ray.
 
• **Other causes** of peptic ulcers include long-term use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (NSAIDs) such as aspirin and ibuprofen

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Protozoan**:

 
 
• **Protozoa are single-celled eukaryotic microorganisms **that can be free-living or parasitic.
 
• They often thrive in** moist environments and are known to cause diseases such as malaria (caused by *Plasmodium* species**).
 
 
 
• **Helminth**:
 
 
• **Helminths are parasitic worms,** including roundworms, flatworms, and flukes.
 
• They **typically inhabit the intestines **and can cause diseases like schistosomiasis and ascariasis.
 
 
 
• **Virus**:
 
 
• **Viruses are microscopic infectious agents **that replicate only inside the living cells of a host.
 
• They are **responsible for a wide range of disease**s, from the common cold to more serious conditions like COVID-19 and HIV/AIDS.
